items.title: 边界VPN group_name命令注入
items.summary_zh: 可访问接口者操控group_name参数注入系统命令，可能完全控制设备。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁，限制接口暴露并过滤group_name参数
items.repro_note: 需访问设备接口并操控group_name参数，确认认证前置
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in WAVLINK WN551X3-A M51X3_V251020-WO-182e965. This affects the function system of the file /bin/ioos of the component WireGuard CLI Group Handler. Such manipulation of the argument group_name leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: WAVLINK路由器data参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操控data参数注入系统命令，可能完全控制WAVLINK WN551X3-A设备。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁，限制设备管理接口暴露并过滤data参数
items.repro_note: 需访问WAVLINK设备接口并操控data参数，确认认证前置
items.impact_scope: 边缘路由器，可能暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was found in WAVLINK WN551X3-A M51X3_V251020-WO-182e965. This impacts the function sub_41a430 of the file /bin/ioos of the component DNS Resolution Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument data results in os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
